💡 SPANISH SHORTCUT MEMORY estufa
Estufa (Es-too-fah) ≈ English "Stove / Stuff" → Same root as English Stove!
💡 HINDI SHORTCUT MEMORY choolha
Choolha (चूल्हा) ≈ Tamil சூளை (Choolai - kiln/furnace) → Tamil Choolai = Hindi Choolha (Stove)!
